frequency_question: How often do labor coalitions with strike authorization and declared intent follow through with a strike within 60 days?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide union federation strike calls where ballots or resolutions passed; excludes single-employer localized strikes and wildcat strikes without official federation backing.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association and UFBU strike call Nov 2012
Central Trade Unions general strike Sep 2016
Central Trade Unions general strike Jan 2019
Central Trade Unions general strike Nov 2020

coverage_note: 10 named major federation-level strike calls in the sector/region; 9 proceeded to strike, 1 was averted at the final reconciliation stage.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional warning strikes that did not involve full national federation mobilization.
validity_reason: Labor relations structures and union federation dynamics in the target sector remain stable over multi-year periods.
